==Overview==
===Format===
* 8 teams
* Double round robin
* Matches are best-of-three
* 1st place gets seeded to the finals
** 2nd place gets seeded to the semifinals
** 3rd and 4th qualify to the playoffs
** 5th, 6th and 7th retain their league spot for the [[LMS/2018/Summer|Summer Split]]
* Last place team plays in the [[LMS/2018/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion]]
* Top 4 qualifies for [[Rift Rivals/2018/LCK-LMS-LPL|Rival Rivals 2018 - LCK vs LMS vs LPL]]
* Winner qualifies for [[Mid_Season_Invitational/2018|Mid Season Invitational 2018]]
